page.layout: One printed title page, single block, centred lines; no margin notes. Stamps (Napoli library stamp, red seal, Google watermark) are excluded.

main_text.l: Confutationem fundamentorum libri Belgici de Mundo fascinato in fine obiter exhibens.

page.notes: Printed in red and black. An ornament (woodcut fleuron) stands between the subtitle and the imprint; no text. Some letters are damaged by stains, notably the year "1692" which is partly obscured by the red seal; read as printed on the scan with uncertainty. The "Apud" line and "1692" share a line with the imprint.
